data.title: Trump Grants Longest-Ever Jones Act Waiver, Allowing Foreign Ships to Move Oil Between US Ports as Iran War Drives Up Fuel Costs
data.description: Trump extends Jones Act waiver for 90 days, allowing foreign ships to transport goods between U.S. ports and ease energy costs.

data.title: Gary Black Says Tesla Board Would Be Reluctant to Hire Jensen Huang, Warns Against Bringing Ex-Nvidia Chief Into Elon Musk's Empire
data.description: On Friday, Gary Black says Tesla’s board would resist hiring former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang due to governance risks.

data.title: Trump Economic Adviser Kevin Hassett Pushes Back On Exit Report Amid White House Shake-Up Speculation After Republican Midterm Rout (UPDATED)
data.description: Kevin Hassett dismisses reports of an impending White House exit, calling speculation about his departure inaccurate.

data.title: Robinhood Gets Its Day at the Supreme Court Over 2021 IPO Disclosures: Here’s What You Should Know
data.description: Supreme Court agrees to hear Robinhood's appeal seeking dismissal of investor claims over alleged misleading disclosures.

data.title: FAA Lifts Nationwide Ground Stop, Resumes Flights; Says No Cyberattack Evidence or Link to Microsoft Outage, Sean Duffy Blames Legacy Equipment, Seeks $50 Billion
data.description: FAA lifts nationwide ground stop after a telecommunications failure disrupted air traffic operations, delaying thousands of flights.
